faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the OPSC Geologist recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the OPSC Geologist recruitment is 08-10-2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the Geologist post?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for the Geologist post is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 42 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Geologist position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Second-Class Master's Degree in Geology or Applied Geology or Earth Science from any recognized University in India to be eligible for the Geologist post.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Geologist post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for the Geologist post by the Odisha Public Service Commission (OPSC).

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the OPSC Geologist recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC candidates is Rs. 700/-. SC/ST candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the OPSC Geologist recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the OPSC Geologist recruitment includes a Written Examination (Objective Type) followed by a Personality Test/Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Geologist post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Geologist post will receive a salary of Rs. 56100 Per Month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided: 5 years for SC/Women/Ex-Servicemen and 10 years for PwD candidates. For SC PwD candidates, the cumulative relaxation is 15 years.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the OPSC Geologist recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official website of OPSC. The application process starts on 08-09-2026 and ends on 08-10-2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for OPSC Geologist recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification for OPSC Geologist recruitment can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article or from the official website of OPSC.
